description: This Java class is a Spring service responsible for handling local file storage operations such as saving, loading, and listing files related to projects within a filesystem directory structure.

classes.name: LocalFileStorageService
classes.description: Spring service class that provides methods to save files to, load files from, and list files in a local directory structure based on project ID and date.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves an uploaded MultipartFile to a project-specific directory, creating necessary subdirectories based on the current date, and returns the absolute path of the stored file.

methods.name: loadAsResource
methods.description: Loads a file as a Spring Resource given its absolute path as a string, facilitating file download or streaming.

methods.name: listProjectFiles
methods.description: Lists all file paths associated with a specific project ID by traversing the project directory.

methods.name: uniqueName
methods.description: Generates a unique filename within a directory by appending a counter if a file with the same name exists.
